North American Telugu Society (NATS) is a non-profit organization formed in 2009 by 200 volunteers.
North American Telugu Society (NATS) serves Telugu communities across North America through cultural, spiritual, social, and educational activities.
North American Telugu Society (NATS) solicited, collected, and disbursed funds for charitable purposes to meet the goals of the organization.
North American Telugu Society (NATS) preserves, propagates, and perpetuates Telugu cultural heritage in North America.
North American Telugu Society (NATS) has a 24x7 helpline number 1-888-483-5848.
North American Telugu Society (NATS) conducts a 3-day convention bi-annually.
North American Telugu Society (NATS) convention attendance is approximately 8000 people.
North American Telugu Society (NATS) is planning to celebrate its 7th annual convention at Raritan Convention Center.
North American Telugu Society (NATS) 7th annual convention is scheduled for May 26-28.

North American Telugu Society (NATS) convention includes cultural, literary, business symposiums, shark tanks, continuing education classes, women's forums, and career development for younger generation.
North American Telugu Society (NATS) invites dignitaries such as Vice President of India Mr. Venkaiah Naidu, Apple Ex-CEO John Scully, Kapil Dev, and Dean of Wharton Business School.
North American Telugu Society (NATS) wants to invite the recipient as a chief guest.
North American Telugu Society (NATS) wants the chief guest to address an exclusive "CXO" group.
North American Telugu Society (NATS) wants the chief guest to share experience as an immigrant and CEO of PepsiCo.
North American Telugu Society (NATS) wants the chief guest to address 8000 people on the mainstage during primetime.
North American Telugu Society (NATS) wants to honor the chief guest with a Lifetime Achievement Award.
